d:
Finally finished this whole epic project... ☺️unfortunately, lately I’ve barely had any time for hobbies. But on the flip side, that’s not necessarily a bad thing during this time, a bunch of new local AI models came out that draw even faster and better. So if anyone notices a noticeable difference in style between some of the images 😅that’s because I started this back in SDXL and finished it in Krea-2. Honestly, the progress is massive. Also, if anyone feels like throwing some appreciation my way for the work, I’d be super grateful there are QR codes around for that. I’ve also been thinking about maybe making some kind of fan-made sequel to this, since the story feels kinda unfinished🤔... but I don’t know. Time is definitely not on my side😔.
